title: Vision Plans Out-of-Network Lens Amounts by Lens Type (Glasses Claims)
content:
**Out-of-network lens schedule — member claims settled on the glasses part, Vision Plans**

On an out-of-network claim settled on its glasses part, the lens amount follows the lens type read from the lens line:

- standard or premium progressive lenses: the plan's out-of-network progressive amount;
- lined trifocals: the plan's out-of-network trifocal amount;
- lined bifocals: the plan's out-of-network bifocal amount;
- single-vision lenses: the plan's out-of-network single-vision amount.

Amounts by plan (USD):

| Plan | Single vision | Lined bifocal | Lined trifocal | Progressive (standard or premium) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cascade Vision Exam Plus | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Cascade Vision Essential 100 | 30.00 | 50.00 | 65.00 | 50.00 |
| Cascade Vision Select 130 | 30.00 | 50.00 | 65.00 | 50.00 |
| Cascade Vision Select 150 | 35.00 | 50.00 | 70.00 | 50.00 |
| Cascade Vision Choice 175 | 40.00 | 60.00 | 80.00 | 60.00 |
| Cascade Vision Premier 200 | 45.00 | 65.00 | 85.00 | 85.00 |

Cascade Vision Exam Plus shows 0.00 throughout because it has no spectacle-lens benefit.

*Hypothetical comparison on Cascade Vision Choice 175.* Lined trifocal lenses with a receipt of 97.30 meet a lens amount of 80.00; the same receipt for single-vision lenses meets 40.00; for premium progressive lenses, 60.00.
